Things you can say here: move the logo up; nudge the logo left 2%; hide the logo. Copy goes in quotes. For exact edits use `design edit`.
The headline has no room to go that far here: it would leave the picture, or go under what x-banner covers. The furthest is headline.dx -0.065 and headline.dy 0.

templates.description: The badge, the headline and its line centered, optional keys, and a window under them with the glyph field in the margins either side. Code is always whole; a picture too tall for the room left rises from the bottom edge and fades into the ground. With no --code or --image the window is left out.
The words on one side and the window on the other with the glyph field round it; stacked on a tall image. The window takes --code or --image and is sized to it.
A mist card with 16px corners and a hairline edge, the glyph field gathering at its edges, the lockup, words and keys centered.
Numbered cards: a title across the top, window-white cards with the blue number, the glyph field round the edges, and a footer with the lockup and the address.
A headline, with an optional badge line above it.
A headline and a short supporting line.
A quotation (--body), with an optional attribution.
A badge line, a headline and an optional flat key.
A screenshot, whole, in the brand's window, with an optional headline.
Code in the dark window, with an optional headline.
A short text in the window, with an optional headline.
A profile picture: the mark, its blue carried to the edges so a circle crop never cuts it. --inset sets the whole mark on the ground instead.
The hero: chip, title and line centered, a window under it with your code or --image, the glyph field in the margins.
A section opener: the number in a chip with the blue [*], the title on the left, the glyph field gathering on the right.
One line, centered, with the glyph field in the margins either side and no window.
A title and up to six points as numbered cards; a point is a heading, or a heading and a line after a colon.
One figure set large on the mist card, with the line that explains it.
A quotation in the display face with its attribution under it.
The words on the left and your --image in a window on the right, the glyph field round it.
The closing card: the lockup, the title and line, the blue and white keys, and the address in the chip.
T-shirt front: 12 by 16 in, DTG or screen print. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
T-shirt back: 12 by 16 in, DTG or screen print. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
Hoodie front: 12 by 10 in, DTG or screen print. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
Cap front panel: 4 by 1.75 in, embroidery. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
Tote bag: 12 by 14 in, screen print or DTG. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
Mug wrap, 11 oz: 9 by 3.5 in, sublimation. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
Sticker, die-cut: 3 by 3 in, die-cut vinyl. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
Poster, 18 by 24 in: 18 by 24 in, digital or offset print. PNG at 100 px per inch (render --scale 3 for 300) and SVG at physical size, bleed included.
The field of * and @: clumps from a noise map that crumble at their coasts, faint ink with short blue runs deep inside, feathering out toward the edges.
A window (mist bar, dimmed arrow, a file-like name, the blue [*]) with code on its blue band, or your --image, and the field gathering round it.
The [*] as a solid slab drawn in characters on a fine grid, shaded from a point light; the brightest faces turn blue.
The hero's system without its stores: nine flat rings of dots nested round the [*] slab, the far side fainter and passing behind it.
Your --image drawn in characters on the mark's fine grid: darker tones take denser glyphs from the mark's ramp, the darkest turn blue, white stays white.
Animated social clip. A label, a headline and an optional supporting line settle in. 2 seconds at 12 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
Announcement clip. A label, a headline and an optional key settle in. 2 seconds at 12 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
Product clip. A window appears, then its lines appear in order. 2 seconds at 12 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
The hero layout plays in once (field, words, then the window rising with its code lines in order) and rests while the glyph field drifts. 4 seconds at 30 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
The window layout: the words settle, the window rises and types its lines, the field drifts round it. 4 seconds at 30 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
The closing card: the lockup, words and keys settle on the mist card while the field drifts at its edges. 4 seconds at 30 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
Numbered cards come in one after another under the title; the field drifts round them. 4 seconds at 30 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
The glyph field alone, drifting as the site draws it: a slow sideways slide and a gentle warp, about 12 redraws a second. 6 seconds at 12 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
The [*] slab in characters, swaying gently as the hero's sun does. 6 seconds at 30 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
The rings of dots round the swaying [*] slab (the hero without its stores). 6 seconds at 30 fps. The PNG is the frame it rests on.
